notes.title: The Kickstarter campaign to improve the game is progressing rapidly!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42015983/09bdb3fc8553ed89cc0e91915c37ed94f80a026b.png[/img]

The crowdfunding campaign published on the platform [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/584154156/presidents-fight]Kickstarter [/url]has already reached a third of its goal.

If we reach our goal we will be able to increase the number of characters, scenarios, and cinematics. And spend more time creating more animations, special attacks, super combos, phrases, and slogans for each president.

The campaign is open until March 29th, and with your support, you can get a lot of exclusive rewards, such as early access to the game, or a customized version of the game with a character with your face, among many other rewards. 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/584154156/presidents-fight]Visit the campaign's website now![/url]

notes.title: We have launched a Kickstarter campaign!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42015983/9ce2e00af3a7a0eae4e29cffb11f040782186f67.png[/img]

We are now working to increase the number of characters, scenarios, and cinematics. And more customization of animations, special attacks,  super combos, phrases, and slogans of each president, to create epic and fun fights.

We want to dedicate more resources to creating the best game possible, and that's why we have launched a Kickstarter campaign where you can already support us.

You will be able to [b]get a customized version of the game with a character with your face[/b] and many more rewards.

[h1][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/584154156/presidents-fight]Visit the campaign website now[/url]
 [/h1]
